cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to call when you're late. Another dinner kept warm until eleven. Are we starting that lesson again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was the train. You remember the excuses beautifully. Tomorrow I eat at seven; you can practise arriving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still expecting your teacher to do the caring part. Miss another call and you'll use those cooking lessons too. Buy your own ingredients; I'm not keeping another dinner warm.
